nodes.label: SESSION_OBSERVATION_BOUNDARY must name the exact manual procedure, and --verify fails when it does not

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - c8-session-and-splash-surfaces [ses_f1069c84fffejHMuwvaB2szvTW].md:L49] An unrecorded boundary is how an audit silently overclaims. A boundary that keeps the key but loses the procedure is worse than a missing key, because it reads as a completed audit, so it fails separately with BOUNDARY_INCOMPLETE.
